# Portolan reference catalog (excerpt)

Collection and style documents copied unchanged from the Portolan reference catalog,
`examples/catalog/portolan-reference/` in https://github.com/portolan-sdi/portolan-spec
(commit d48bae01c3fb), licensed Apache-2.0. Hosted copy:
https://data.source.coop/portolan-mirrors/portolan-spec-examples/portolan-reference/main/

Only the JSON documents are here; the data files they reference are not.
